receipt.question: Which evidence supports the offline conformance claim, and which live-system claims remain excluded?

viewpoint.actor: GPTQueue principal approving the first governed harness

semantic_scope.summary: The approved brief, exact source, hand-authored module, governed focused run, evidence classes, and explicit live-system claim ceiling.

relevance_rules: Show every stage that determines whether the focused offline result may support a conformance claim.
Show the exact source and hand-authored provenance boundaries.
Keep separate corroboration visibly distinct from governed evidence.

omissions.reason: Retry timing, retention, dead-letter behavior, authorization, and launcher design are explicitly outside the approved wedge.
The approved path is hand-authored because provider dispatch lacks an enforced spend ceiling.

uncertainties.statement: A later live-product harness will require independently approved and enforced Redis, acknowledgement, and runtime-launch boundaries.
